prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Use system tray controls to summon, hide, feed, or chat with your pet anytime.", "Controls Quickstart"]
2: ["Select Companion"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop", "We are calibrating your pet screen coordinates and checking desktop overlay permissions.", "Desktop Sync Status", "Desktop Placement Tips"]
4: ["Save & Restore Your Pet Anytime", "Sign in to securely cloud-sync your pet data and prevent lost progress across sessions.", "Your pet customization and stats will be linked safely to your cloud account."]
5: ["What to expect on your desktop"]
6: ["Choose How to Adopt Your Desktop Pet", "Select a ready-to-play pet companion in seconds, or upload photos to build a custom pet.", "Preset pets take 10 seconds; custom pet photo upload takes ~1 minute."]
7: ["Your Companion Has Arrived!", "Look at the bottom right corner of your desktop screen to find your pet active and waiting.", "Start Interacting"]
8: ["Upload Clear Photos for Best Pet Results", "Upload well-lit front-facing images so your pet renders accurately on your desktop.", "If generation takes too long, you can select from our preset avatars at any time."]
9: ["Meet Your New Desktop Workspace Buddy", "Your desktop pet lives alongside your open windows, cheering you on throughout your work day.", "Scroll down or press continue to select your pet companion."]
